# Master agreement (`agreement` v1)

ISDA, GMRA or GMSLA master agreement with its key elections.

**Group:** Counterparty and legal · **Mnemonic:** `AGR` · **Identifiers:** `AGR-…` in `agreementId`

Open one with `AGR <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: agreement
version: 1
description: "ISDA, GMRA or GMSLA master agreement with its key elections."
match: { kind: agreement, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Counterparty and legal · Master agreement, id: $.agreementId }
strip:
  - { label: Type, bind: $.type }
  - { label: Counterparty, bind: $.counterpartyName }
  - { label: Governing law, bind: $.governingLaw }
  - { label: Signed, bind: $.signed, fmt: date }
  - { label: Close-out netting, bind: $.closeOutNetting, emphasis: true }
panels:
  - id: elections
    kind: kv
    title: Elections
    key: F2
    rows: $.elections
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.counterparty, 'counterparty')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```
